<@1252939266871263294> and Amir, I would advise to use Java’s/Javascript’s big integer library to start with because the API doesn’t change between that and having an optimised ffi library.

Whereas the ffi library will probably take more time, and the main benefit we get from it versus just using big integer initially is that we have more accurate benchmarking/gas numbers.

Another benefit of doing the big integer approach is that it allows better parallelism of work. If we get a big integer implementation using the programming languages native types, then someone else can work on the ffi implementation while another person works on the evm part
